context: The one genuine name dispute between the gemini and openai passes on index18; the other four disagreements are convention questions.

rows.line: This is the limit of relying on others!!
rows.reasoning: Carissa has been mocking Vilian's reliance on others two turns earlier - 'Justifying your reliance on others? It sickens me to think we're sisters'. The target continues that taunt, and the narration immediately after has Carissa act: 'Now that Vilian didn't have any other way, Carissa swung the Curtana Original.' The reply that follows - 'Yes, this is the pinnacle of reliance upon others, my sister' - opens with 'Yes' and turns 'limit' into 'pinnacle', which only works as Vilian answering Carissa, not as Vilian answering herself.
